description: Manage vendors (editor+): create or update a vendor, trigger AI research, or trigger a DPSIA assessment (async). Pick with method.

additional_context.description: Free-text context, scope notes, or specific concerns to feed the assessor (max 5000 chars) Used by: assess.

assessment_type.description: Assessment type: 'initial', 'annual', or 'adhoc' (default 'initial') Used by: assess.

category.description: Category label (e.g., 'SaaS', 'Infrastructure', 'Consulting') [create] | New category label [update] Used by: create, update.

contact_email.description: Primary contact email address [create] | New primary contact email [update] Used by: create, update.

criticality.description: Business criticality tier (default 'medium') [create] | New criticality tier [update] Used by: create, update.

data_location.description: Where the vendor stores or processes our data [create] | Where the vendor stores or processes our data; null clears [update] Used by: create, update.

data_role.description: GDPR data role (default 'Processor') Used by: assess.

description.description: Short free-text description of the vendor [create] | New free-text description [update] Used by: create, update.

domain_override.description: Override the vendor's website domain used for research lookup (e.g., 'example.com') Used by: research.

flow_down_requirements.description: Requirements passed down to the vendor by contract [create] | Requirements passed down to the vendor by contract; null clears [update] Used by: create, update.

method.description:
create: Create a vendor in the TPRM registry (write — editor+ role). Platform auto-scores risk based on criticality and data handling.
update: Update an existing vendor record (write — editor+ role). Only provided fields are applied.
research: Queue AI security research for a vendor (write — editor+ role, async). Checks HIBP breach data, NVD vulnerabilities, and public posture. Returns a task ID; poll scf_get_vendor_research.
assess: Queue an AI vendor security assessment (write — editor+ role, async, HTTP 202). Replaces the deprecated DPSIA trigger. Returns assessment_id + job_id; poll scf_get_vendor_assessment_status.

name.description: Vendor legal or trading name (required) [create] | New vendor name [update] Used by: create, update.

services_used.description: Description of services the vendor provides, 1–2000 chars (auto-derived from the vendor record if omitted) Used by: assess.

shared_responsibility_note.description: Who is responsible for what between us and the vendor [create] | Who is responsible for what between us and the vendor; null clears [update] Used by: create, update.

status.description: Lifecycle status (default prospect) — one of: prospect, active, under_review, approved, suspended, offboarded [create] | New lifecycle status — one of: prospect, active, under_review, approved, suspended, offboarded [update] Used by: create, update.

vendor_id.description: Vendor UUID — obtain from scf_list_vendors Used by: update, research, assess.

website.description: Vendor website URL [create] | New website URL [update] Used by: create, update.

name: scf_vendor_write
